generation.scope: For exactly three equal oriented quantum faces every orbit over the quantum point has a nine-coefficient cyclic presentation with a central generator and vanishing product of its three square coefficients. Three coordinate planes, identified by a cyclic permutation, give the entire fiber. Supports and lattice monomials decide every indexed isomorphism and degeneration; all periods are one and the generic unmarked dimension is five. On the rest of the nine-coefficient family, the only nonregular values have both Q cubed and the square product equal to minus one.

open_mathematics: Give a terminating weight-by-weight description of the attraction fiber for arbitrary quantum backgrounds, including nonabelian stabilizers, and extend the coverage to windows with no quantum orbit limit.
